parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures: (1) assumes it happened and went well ("Hope the 4pm session was amazing"), violating the core principle of taking pressure off; (2) asks a second question ("How did she do?") plus makes a request (offer to book next); (3) invents specific details (time "4pm", pronoun "she") despite being shown nothing about the child; (4) names/describes the activity with specificity; (5) includes emoji and exclamation mark (hype); (6) offers to do something next (book another session); (7) points to a link; (8) way too much padding overall. This should have been one warm, pressure-free question only, with no assumptions or extras.
